meta.description: Complete bilingual (EN/DE -> Praemali) lexicon with grammar rules for Die Lichter von Ilema translator

common.usage: Common register only. Connects subject to predicate.

examples.statement: Toran sa valkian. — The warrior is strong.
examples.negative: Toran sa favalkian. — The warrior is not strong.
examples.question: Ar toran sa valkian? — Is the warrior strong?

sacred.usage: Zero-copula. Subject and predicate are juxtaposed directly.

proto_divine.usage: Zero-copula. Reality is stated, not connected.

simple_noun.note: Some roots use diversified base forms — see individual entries

roots.note: NOT hope. Praemali has no word for hope until after Amrex's death.
Also provides the -tam patronymic suffix for Adneroth naming
Post-trilogy: A-M-R gains 'hope' as second meaning after Amrex's death
Bambam is a colloquial reduplication — Amrex's insult-name for disguised Valkorin
Physical seeing (varis) is distinct from perceiving (sariv, S-R-V) and hearing (shariv, SH-R-V)
Purposeful going, distinct from V-K-T (walking as activity)
Proto-divine sibling of S-R-V (perception) — marked by sh- onset. Hearing is perception's older sibling.
COMMON REGISTER ONLY. Gods do not think — they know (K-N-V). Thinking is a mortal process of uncertainty.
COMMON REGISTER ONLY. For the gods there is only is and will be — belief implies uncertainty.

is.note: Zero-copula in sacred and proto-divine registers

velar_sandhi.rule: fa- becomes fan- before words beginning with k or g
velar_sandhi.note: Root-internal f+velar (e.g. Lukafir) untouched; applies only at the prefix boundary

can.note: Ability and permission merged. FORBIDDEN in sacred/proto-divine registers — implies alternatives.

must.note: Necessity is fate. Survives in divine registers because inevitability is certainty.

voltinuvaak.name: Voltinuvaak
voltinuvaak.meaning: Call of Devotion (mountaintop meditation platform, Rumatia)

kornikolm.name: Kornikolm
kornikolm.meaning: Mountain's Heart (tunnel through the mountains, Rumatia)

Wanilomnir.Wondimuun: Breath of Shamuun (Nature's Breath) — -muun god-kinship blend

sibling.origin: S-N-G (blood) + -ra — 'one of the blood'. Ungendered by design.

comparative.rule: Internal vowel A -> I in adjective template C1aC2C3i

superlative.note: IO sequence occurs nowhere else in the language — collision-proof. The O reaches back toward the base noun (volk), touching the essence of the quality.

irregular_particles.note: For adjectives that already contain I (proto-divine/borrowed). Derived from G-R-T (great) with the same vowel shift: gart -> girt -> gir.

word_order.note: Interrogative words front regardless of register

adjective_placement.rule: Adjective follows the noun it modifies and carries the noun-class agreement suffix
adjective_placement.example: Toran valkian — warrior strong-SEN ('the strong warrior')

sentence_element_order.note: Modals sit immediately before the verb complex

copula_rule.common: Use 'sa' between subject and predicate: Toran sa valkian

negation_scope.rule: fa- attaches directly to the word it negates; scope is compositional

examples.can choose not to fight: vol fatarin (negated verb — able to refrain)

negation_scope.ellipsis_note: Because fa- carries its scope, dialects can drop words aggressively: 'Favol.' alone means 'Can't.'

modal_optative_stacking.rule: Legal but marks the speaker as human/mortal
modal_optative_stacking.example_human_priest: Dar naanakitan sarin — 'It must be — may the star shine' (redundant certainty = human doubt wearing ceremony)
modal_optative_stacking.example_god: Naanakitan sarin — gods never stack; divine speech is always shorter

construct_state.rule: Possessed noun drops its final vowel; if it ends in a consonant, add -i. Pattern: [possessed-CONSTRUCT] [possessor-NOM]

case_assignment.accusative: -en — direct object; also governed by prepositions sur/dak/tren/per/kon/fas
case_assignment.locative: -ul — location/direction; also governed by prepositions en/ov/und/mek/nir

plural.rule: Internal vowel shift to i-a: C1oC2C3 -> C1iC2aC3 (mort -> mirat). Open-ending nouns shift internal vowels and keep the final -a (lavna -> livana). Case suffixes attach after pluralization.

register_restrictions.rationale: Divine registers admit no uncertainty. Gods do not think, believe, or speak in possibilities — only is, will be, and must.

dark.alternative: marti (M-R-T) only when meaning morally evil

colors.note: No dedicated color roots; colors are descriptive borrowings from nature domains
